notes.title: TURN THE LIGHTS CAREFULLY is available
notes.notes:
[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303620/Turn_on_the_lights_carefully/]PLAY IT NOW[/url][/h2]

[previewyoutube=Xhmf6QCRuco;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Turn on the lights carefully[/b] is a disassemble puzzle game that features a recursive mechanics in which the player has to explore micro pieces to connect a circuit and solve the main puzzle.

Key features:

[list][*]Minimalist design and colors[/list]
[list][*]Relaxing soundtrack[/list]
[list][*]Chill game[/list]
[list][*]No time pressure[/list]
[list][*]Steam achievements[/list]
